chunks.text: Can a machine feel? Like, actually feel? AI can solve equations, write code, hold a conversation — but can it show mercy? Can it know remorse?
This book, The Digital Mind and the Human Heart, asks the question nobody's asking: what happens when machines get smarter than us, but still have no heart?
It made me rethink everything about AI. About what makes us human. About what we lose if we hand the machine the keys.
If you've ever wondered where all this is going, you need to read this. Link in bio.
